title: Table-driven tests
hints: Add rows to the table, one per kind of input: ASCII text, text with multi-byte characters such as "héllo" or "日本", and the empty string.
t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) { ... }) runs each row as a named subtest, so a failure says which case broke and you can run one with -run TestReverse/name.
Reversing bytes breaks UTF-8: "héllo" turns into invalid text. A version that indexes s[0] panics on "". Your table needs a row that exposes each one.
